searchText: will this be recorded? From the pm issue: "Youtube Recording: to be uploaded after the call" Call in 30 minutes 😄! Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/81450148113?pwd=dXBaNnpyV2t3dWdJaVgxdnJiQWo4QT09 <recklessengineer> Repo that Carl shared today on KZG ceremony specs: https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs and discussions best directed towards <#974028042257190933> channel ( <@851595749581127740> ) Demo code by <@159152274659082240> and <@918333659327655968> : https://github.com/Inphi/eip4844-interop <recklessengineer> Notes document: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1KgKZnb5P07rdLBb_nRCaXhzG_4PBoZXtFQNzKO2mrvc/edit#heading=h.qalxl5autws8 <asn_d6> Didnt get time to get into that but there is two open PRs (one for the EIP, the other for consensusspecs) that slecify optimized tx/block verification and need to be merged (or rejected). Any reviews/comments would be great to bring the spec to sync. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2915 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/5088 I put together the following HackMD to track the various open issues that got discussed on the call today: https://notes.ethereum.org/@timbeiko/4844-open-issues If I've missed something, please let me know and I'll add it. Not a great place to put this on GH yet, but I'll add it to eip4844.com Thanks for the call, it was very interesting. I have a question about sidecars: in EIP-4844 will beacon nodes be required to download all sidecars? Some sidecars? No sidecars? My gut feeling is that data in sidecars is only interesting to rollups, but on the other hand without some form of sidecar validation you could put whatever you want as the blob reference, and the beacon node would just accept it. We'll download everything with a prune threshold
